Hello LAVAAN members

Foundations of Questionnaire Design led by Daniel Schnitzlein (University of Applied Labour Studies (Instats) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar on Foundations of Questionnaire Design offers crucial techniques for collecting accurate and meaningful data for quantitative research. For researchers utilizing lavaan for latent variable analysis, robust data collection through well-designed instruments is paramount for valid model estimation. Participants will gain practical skills to craft surveys that minimize bias and error, directly enhancing the reliability and interpretability of their latent variable models.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
